import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()

        # Branch 1: 1x1 convolution
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Branch 2: 1x1 convolution followed by 3x3 convolution
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=64, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Branch 3: 1x1 convolution followed by two consecutive 3x3 convolutions
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=64, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=64, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Branch 4: Average pooling followed by 1x1 convolution
        self.branch4 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Fully connected layers
        self.fc_layers = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_features=64*4*32*32, out_features=512),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Linear(in_features=256, out_features=10)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process each branch
        branch1_out = self.branch1(x)
        branch2_out = self.branch2(x)
        branch3_out = self.branch3(x)
        branch4_out = self.branch4(x)

        # Concatenate outputs along the channel dimension
        concatenated = torch.cat([branch1_out, branch2_out, branch3_out, branch4_out], dim=1)

        # Flatten and pass through fully connected layers
        flattened = torch.flatten(concatenated, 1)
        output = self.fc_layers(flattened)

        return output

    input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 3, 32, 32)  # Batch size 1, 3 channels, 32x32 image
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)

            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=64, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Branch 3: 1x1 convolution followed by two consecutive 3x3 convolutions
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),

            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=64, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Branch 4: Average pooling followed by 1x1 convolution
        self.branch4 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.2)
        )

        # Fully connected layers
        self.fc_layers = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_features=64*4*32*32, out_features=512),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Linear(in_features=256, out_features=10)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process each branch
        branch1_out = self.branch1(x)
        branch2_out = self.branch2(x)
        branch3_out = self.branch3(x)
        branch4_out = self.branch4(x)

        # Concatenate outputs along the channel dimension
        concatenated = torch.cat([branch1_out, branch2_out, branch3_out, branch4_out], dim=1)

        flattened = torch.flatten(concatenated, 1)

        return output

    model = DL_Model()
